preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**6 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of elements n is between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 10**9 for a in as_ for i in range(len(a)))
preconditions.description: Each element a[i] in the sequence is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == 'YES' if all(abs(a[j] - (j + 1)) <= 1 for j in range(n)) else output[i] == 'NO' for i, (n, a) in enumerate(zip(ns, as_)))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is 'YES' if all numbers are within 1 position of their sorted position, otherwise 'NO'.
